- scripts/targeted_file_context.py:normalize_path (lines 240-247), the deletion of `is_sensitive_target_path` (former lines 152-167), and the removal of the post-resolution check in `emit_context` | severity=blocker | confidence=5

  PROBLEM: Sensitive-path rejection was removed.
  WHY: Untrusted plan, issue, or PR paths can inline `.git/config`, `.env`, `.ssh/id_rsa`, `.aws/credentials`, and other sensitive files into model-visible context.
- scripts/targeted_file_context.py:Removal of MAX_TARGET_PATHS (former 256) and MAX_TARGET_PATH_BYTES (former 1024); emit_context path loop (lines 568-579 onward) | severity=blocker | confidence=5

  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]

- scripts/write_codex_config.sh:argument parser (lines 95-115), base_url emission (261) | severity=blocker | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]

  WHY: Brokered Codex phases fail with `unknown argument: --provider-base-url`; dropping the flag would bypass the broker's credential isolation and policy enforcement.

- tests/test_git_auth_hygiene.py:test_production_git_urls_do_not_embed_tokens (lines 51-55), test_networked_git_steps_use_ephemeral_authentication (lines 95-102), approval/successor helper tests (lines 111-178, 271-334, 337-343, 376-406) | severity=blocker | confidence=5

  PROBLEM: Existing security-contract tests assert credential-free URLs, `_memory_git`, credential stripping, and review-blocked helper definitions that the PR removes.
  WHY: The credential-hygiene and review-blocked contract suite fails through URL matches, missing patterns, and function-not-found errors.
- scripts/implement_commit_changes.sh:lines 59-68 | severity=major | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The trackedness probe checks the index with `git ls-files`, but the preserve branch restores from `HEAD`.
  WHY: An index-only `pre_assembled_static.txt` is treated as present in `HEAD`; `git restore --source=HEAD` then fails under `set -e`.
- scripts/model_provider_broker.py:BrokerState.reserve_request (lines 183-198) | severity=blocker | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: Total-output reservations charge the requested maximum and are never released or reconciled with actual upstream usage.
  WHY: With the shipped defaults, exactly four 16,384-token reservations exhaust the 65,536-token budget, causing later requests to receive HTTP 429 even when actual usage is low.
- .github/workflows/implement.yml:bare model_provider_broker_start at lines 1737, 3198, 4540 vs. the fallback switch at lines 2322-2325 | severity=major | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Implement broker starts allow only `MODEL_EDITOR`, while the retry loop switches to `MODEL_EDITOR_FALLBACK`.
  WHY: The capacity-fallback model is rejected as unauthorized, so the documented recovery path cannot run.
- scripts/model_provider_broker.py:do_POST (lines 233-275) | severity=major | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603]
  PROBLEM: The broker rejects requests without `Content-Type: application/json` before policy checks.
  WHY: Codex streaming retries or recovery probes with a missing or changed header receive HTTP 415 and can block model-facing workflows.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:heal_integration_branch_conflict (lines 8440-8471); extract_autofix_resolver_retry_state_from_comments (lines 5652-5684) | severity=major | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: Non-1 selector errors warn and return success without resetting `integration_conflict_unresolved_ticks`.
  WHY: Temporary selector or keyring failures can stop redispatching without consuming retry budget or surfacing the cause, allowing a conflict to remain indefinitely.
- scripts/orchestrate_state_v2.py:cmd_select_resolver_retry (lines 716-779) | severity=major | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: Individual comment bodies are not bounded beyond `RESOLVER_RETRY_MAX_BYTES + 64`, and oversized bodies are silently skipped.
  WHY: Oversized comments become “no candidate” results without diagnostics; one actuator treats this as a hard error and bypasses existing-comment lookup.
- scripts/orchestrate_state_v2.py:cmd_select_resolver_retry (lines 749-762); the comment-iteration block | severity=nit | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The selector requires the exact trailing `\n-->` envelope suffix.
  WHY: A truncated or altered near-limit comment can be silently excluded even when its inner JSON is valid.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:extract_autofix_resolver_retry_state_from_comments (lines 5652-5684); heal_integration_branch_conflict (lines 8440-8471) | severity=nit | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: Comment pagination and selection can race with another actuator posting a newer marker.
  WHY: The two callers can converge on different marker-generation decisions, causing occasional duplicate posts or one-tick staleness.
- scripts/review_conflict_actuate.sh:select-resolver-retry invocation with --head-sha "${live_head_sha}" (lines 61-79) | severity=nit | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k3]
  PROBLEM: Update-in-place lookup requires the existing marker's signed `head_sha` to equal the live head.
  WHY: After head movement, the actuator posts a new marker instead of refreshing the prior one, causing marker accumulation and extra API writes.
- scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh:patch_diagnose_reasoning_into_config (line 100) | severity=nit | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k3]
  PROBLEM: The local-variable line has mixed tab-and-space indentation.
  WHY: Bash ignores the whitespace functionally, but it is a style regression that can trigger shellcheck or editor-induced damage.
- scripts/targeted_file_context.py:emit_context (lines 536-716) | severity=major | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k3]
  PROBLEM: Rewritten budget accounting can append headers and markers beyond `max_bytes`.
  WHY: Unbudgeted output is appended before overflow checks, so the documented total output bound is not enforced.
